spec.name: mediatastelibrary-argument-desktop
spec.description: The argument, in chapters. Every scrubbed effect derives from one scrubbed proxy tween (scrub 0.6) mapped against these ranges, measured from the built page: a scene starts when its section enters at 85% of the viewport and ends when the next one does. Two signature moments (the load: grid, count and 131 modules; the ink flip into 'What broke') are time/state-based and checked in verify.sh, not here.

scenes.label: 01 — the walk visits the six steps (held stops)

expectations.note: --walk drives offset-distance through measured marker positions; 60% travel / 40% hold per leg; markers fill as reached.

scenes.label: 01 — the contact sheet, rows in award order
02 — the thesis is underlined as it is read (ink ground)

expectations.note: The 1,118 and the spec figures count ONCE on enter (time-based), so they are not scroll-asserted.

scenes.label: 05 — the exhibit dot rides the page's own ease
